title: Agent loop analysis report records code-grounded findings

documentation.title: Analysis report covers the requested loop questions
documentation.test: The handoff document must answer the requested questions about streamed intermediate outputs, tool-result follow-up blocking, sub-agent and agent-job behavior, and initial instruction assembly.

steps.instruction: Inspect the new package documentation report after implementation.
steps.expected: The report has explicit sections for response stream handling, tool follow-up accumulation, collaboration placeholder behavior, and startup/context instruction construction.

documentation.passCriteria: The report answers every requested question with concrete file-path evidence.

verification.title: Documentation-only continuation remains deployable
verification.test: The existing branch changes plus the added analysis report must still satisfy the repository verification contract.

steps.instruction: Run npm run deploy from the repository root after the report is added.
steps.expected: The command exits successfully or records a concrete blocker.

verification.passCriteria: Deploy succeeds, or any failure is captured with specific command evidence.
